eval_plan: Sweep K in {8,24,48,80,120} clauses under clang++ -std=c++17 -O2 monolithic vs B=8 partitioned.
hypothesis: Boost.Proto crv_constraint C++17 clang++ -O2 compile time scales superlinearly (~O(K^1.6-2.1)) beyond K=35-50 clauses; partitioning into B=8 sub-constraints cuts compile latency >3x with identical Z3 QF_BV semantics.
measured: At K=120 clauses, monolithic clang++ -O2 took 1845.4 ms vs 295.1 ms for --partition-clauses 8 (6.25x speedup; 2.68x at K=80; EquivalentUnsat preserved).

eval_plan: Sample 10^5 draws on [0:2] :/ 10, 3 := 2 and [0:15] :/ 5, 16 := 5 in live Accellera CRAVE with and without LCM weight scaling and hard-bound interval clipping.
hypothesis: Non-divisible dist :/ ranges (span S not dividing W, S > W) exhibit >0.05 empirical TVD/chi2 divergence between SV simulators and CRAVE add_weighted_range unless weights are LCM-scaled and clipped against hard bounds during legalization.
measured: Confirmed in live CRAVE (10^5 draws): integer-floor per-element :/ lowering collapses to TVD=0.5000 (chi2=100,000) on [0:15]:/5,16:=5 (eliminated to TVD=0.0043 by LCM scaling; chi2 drops 14.52->2.28 on [0:2]:/10,3:=2), and hard constraints slicing inside weighted_range cause CRAVE boundary clamping (TVD=0.0978, chi2=4541.6 on x>=1; TVD=0.0742 on x>=8), which svcc-passes interval clipping + LCM eliminates to TVD=0.0016 (chi2=1.64, 60.8x TVD reduction) and TVD=0.0014 (chi2=2.54).

eval_plan: Drive burst trace ant=11100, con=00010 on ##[1:3] and 10^7 random cycles across ##[1:3]..##[4:32] + Z3 cycle-exact BMC.
hypothesis: 64-bit pending_window_ bitmask SVA observer matches IEEE 1800 assert failure counts on 100% of traces, but under-counts overlapping back-to-back cover property multiplicity by up to (max-min)x unless per-age hit counters are used.
measured: Confirmed both formally (Z3 cycle-exact BMC: EquivalentUnsat on pending_age_ vs CounterexampleSat on bitmask) and empirically: bitmask under-counts canonical bursts 3x..26x (and 2.08x..6.13x over 10^7 random cycles) vs 0 error for pending_age_ at 1.63-4.21 ns/cycle.

eval_plan: 2-branch join_any race with identical #100ns delays mutating a shared counter.
hypothesis: Cooperative atomic<bool> cancel_tok in sc_spawn can execute one extra intra-delta side effect on simultaneous wakeups unless post-wait cancel guards are inserted after every sc_core::wait inside forked branches.

eval_plan: Benchmark full-period 2^W randomize() loops in live CRAVE for W in {4,6,8,10,12,16}.
hypothesis: History-vector randc emulation in CRAVE hits >10 ms/solve cliff at W >= 11 bits (2048 exclusions), whereas constrained Feistel permutation stays <100 us up to W=24.
measured: Confirmed in live CRAVE: explicit history-exclusion crosses >10 ms last-step at W=8 (10.24 ms) and hits 25.78 ms/call mean (26.40 s full period) at W=10, while native CRAVE randc throws std::runtime_error above W=16; svcc_randc_feistel<W> runs in 0.0029-0.0031 us/call pure (75.5-85.0 us/call with live CRAVE Z3 dependent constraints, 341x faster at W=10) with 100% bijective coverage up to W=32.

eval_plan: Run svcc sv2sc across 12 standalone UVM/RAL VIPs with CST fallback toggled.
hypothesis: Hybrid svlang semantic + lossless CST type recovery transpiles >=3x more standalone open-source UVM files cleanly (clang++ -Werror passing) without full -f filelists than semantic-AST-only lowering.
measured: Hybrid svlang + CST fallback preserved UVM/RAL roles and passed clang++ -Werror on 12/12 (100%) standalone VIPs vs 4/12 (33.3%, single-item VIPs only) under --no-cst-fallback (3.0x improvement).

eval_plan: Compare structural vs libclang SSA lowering on 10 C++17 DSP/CRC/AES reference functions against SV RTL in InFormal check_sec.
hypothesis: C++ implicit integer promotion (uint8_t + uint8_t -> signed int) causes >=15% silent width/sign mismatches in structural C2RTL translators on DSP/crypto kernels; libclang AST promotion capture reduces false CEXs to 0.
